{

  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",

  "explanation": "The operator requested SPP validation with default parameters and audit logging enabled. The request is mapped to the allowed region SWPP, a 60-minute horizon, and default shortfall cost 20.0 with cost_reserve 1.0. The rolling design uses train_days=730, cal_days=30, test_days=30, and rolling_step_days=30. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",

    "future_weather",

    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"

  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "SWPP",
    "horizon_minutes": 60,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 20.0,

      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_regions_horizons_costs_and_rolling_design",
    "construct_admissible_and_forbidden_variable_sets",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "configure_rolling_window_train_cal_test_step",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_upward_reserve_sizing",
    "record_numerical_outputs_and_audit_log",
    "require_human_approval_before_any_operational_use"
  ]
